Name: Vincent and Jas at Lemonade Stand
Author: ConsciouslyLazy
Description:
I thought it would be cute if there were chlidren at the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24190]Seasonal Lemonade Stand[/url]. Please read the description in the link for more info. Also make sure to download all the requirements for the Seasonal Lemonade Stand mod if you want it to fully function.

This mod only adds schedule and dialogue of Vincent and Jas.
